name: harness-improver
description: Fixes defects in the harness-loop skill itself (templates/scripts), dispatched with one ranked issue from harness-loop/harness-issues.jsonl. May also mirror an approved fix into an affected target's already-scaffolded copy — the prompt's invariants (fix the template first, one issue per iteration, prove via --reverify) are what keep it from patching a target alone, not a path restriction, since targets live outside this repo.
